pages.title: Gian Standing with Hands on Hips Beside Concrete Pipes Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian stands with his hands on his hips beside the vacant lot's concrete pipes in this printable coloring page, wearing his familiar zigzag shirt. His wide smile, shorts, and large shoes fill the foreground, while stacked pipes, bushes, and neighboring houses add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Gian Singing with a Microphone Atop Concrete Pipes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian singing into a microphone atop the concrete pipes at his neighborhood concert, with one arm stretched out beside him. Doraemon and Nobita sit below, smiling and clapping. The coloring sheet combines Gian's broad shirt and the rounded pipes with smaller microphone, grass, and tree details.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Teaching Nobita a Singing Lesson in the Vacant Lot Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian teaches Nobita a singing lesson in the vacant lot in this printable coloring page, raising one arm while holding his other hand against his chest. Nobita looks up through round glasses with his hands near his shirt. Concrete pipes and low garden walls frame the two figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Composing a Song with the Melody Tadpoles and Their Singing Frogs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gian composing a song with the Melody Tadpoles and singing frogs, holding a pencil and paper beside a lily pond. Nobita and Doraemon watch behind him as musical notes curve overhead. Frogs on rocks, smiling tadpoles, and a small round gadget create numerous enclosed details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Reading a Pile of Fan Letters Beside His Autograph Board Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian reads a pile of fan letters beside his autograph board in this printable coloring page, sitting cross-legged with envelopes in both hands and a broad smile. Heart seals decorate the scattered mail, and his displayed portrait gives a thumbs-up. Repeated envelope shapes surround the large central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Playing the Tuba in Nobita's Earth Symphony Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian playing the tuba in Nobita's Earth Symphony, wearing a bow tie and long-tailed jacket while pressing the instrument's valves. His puffed cheeks and raised eyebrows show his playing expression. The coloring sheet contrasts the tuba's broad flared bell with tightly curved tubing and smaller buttons.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Stirring His Signature Stew in a Large Cooking Pot Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian stirs his signature stew in a large cooking pot in this printable coloring page, smiling while holding a long ladle above the bubbling mixture. Steam curls around the outlined chunks of food. Broad spaces across the pot and his zigzag shirt keep the coloring sheet focused on the cooking scene.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Sharing a Mystery Hot-pot Dinner with Suneo at His Home Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian sharing a mystery hot-pot dinner with Suneo at home, both holding bowls and chopsticks around a round dining table. A steaming pot packed with leafy vegetables sits on a tabletop burner. The coloring sheet includes small food shapes and the larger outlines of chairs, curtains, and clothing.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Celebrating His Birthday with Jaiko Beside a Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian celebrates his birthday with Jaiko beside a cake in this printable coloring page, raising both fists as she clasps her hands and smiles beside him. Striped candles and piped decorations top the round cake. Jaiko's beret, the tablecloth folds, and the characters' broad clothing areas give the coloring sheet distinct sections.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Serving a Customer Behind the Counter of His Family's Grocery Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian serving a customer behind the counter of his family's grocery shop, handing over a filled shopping bag with a smile. Bottles, jars, and boxes line the shelves behind him. Produce crates and the customer's shoulder bag add smaller shapes around the two central figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Gian Carrying a Box Outside a Neighborhood Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian carries a delivery box from his family's shop along the neighborhood street in this printable coloring page, stepping forward with both hands around the parcel. The open shop entrance and scalloped awning remain behind him. Wide box panels contrast with house windows, wall blocks, and overhead wires on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Making a Gorilla Face to Cheer Up a Baby in the Family Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian making a gorilla face to cheer up a baby in the family shop, pulling his cheeks beside the baby's high chair. The smiling baby raises both hands toward him. Shelves of jars, boxes, and bottles frame the figures, adding repeated small shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Proudly Showing Jaiko's Manga to Suneo Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian proudly shows Jaiko's manga to Suneo in this printable coloring page, holding the book open so its illustrated panels face forward between the two boys. Flowers, a heart, and expressive characters appear inside the comic. The coloring sheet places these miniature drawings against Gian's larger shirt and the simple neighborhood background.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Listening Sheepishly as His Mother Scolds Him Outside the Family Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian listening sheepishly while his mother scolds him outside the family shop, her finger raised as he looks downward beside her. He holds one hand behind his head, and she wears a tied apron. Vegetables, an awning, and storefront frames add background details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Helping Muku Search for Shizuka's Lost Pet Bird Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian helps Muku search for Shizuka's lost pet bird in this printable coloring page, looking upward beneath a leafy tree while the dog sniffs nearby. The bird sits on a branch above an empty cage with its door open. The coloring sheet pairs broad character outlines with fur, leaves, and cage bars.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Swinging a Baseball Bat During a Neighborhood Game Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gian swinging a baseball bat during a neighborhood game, gripping it with both hands as a stitched ball approaches from beside him. His wide stance and angled bat dominate the scene. Home plate, grass tufts, neighboring roofs, and a block wall complete the baseball coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Pitching a Baseball Toward Nobita at the Vacant Lot Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian pitches a baseball toward Nobita at the vacant lot in this printable coloring page, following through with one foot lifted and his throwing arm extended. Nobita waits at home plate with his bat raised. A glove, shoe-tread lines, and the ball's stitching add smaller sports details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Giving a Team Talk to Nobita and Suneo Before a Giants Baseball Game Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian giving Nobita and Suneo a team talk before a Giants baseball game, standing between them with one fist near his chest. Nobita holds a glove while Suneo rests a bat beside his foot. The three full figures and a foreground baseball anchor the open vacant-lot coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Facing Nobita in a Friendly Sumo Match Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian faces Nobita in a friendly sumo match in this printable coloring page, both smiling as they crouch with their hands raised inside a circular ring. Their bent knees and wide-set feet define the central poses. The coloring sheet leaves open areas inside the ring, with scattered grass and a low wall beyond.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Operating Suneo's Remote-controlled Toy at the Vacant Lot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gian operating Suneo's remote-controlled toy at the vacant lot, holding a controller while Suneo watches with his hands on his hips. An antenna-topped racing buggy sits in the foreground. Its wheels, suspension coils, and rear wing supply smaller details beneath the boys' larger clothing shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Fishing Beside Suneo at the Stream Behind Their School Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian fishes beside Suneo at the stream behind their school in this printable coloring page, both seated on the grassy bank with long rods angled outward. Two fish rise among ripples near their lines. The coloring sheet includes rocks, water contours, and rows of school windows around the two large figures.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Playing Tabletop Paper Sumo with Nobita in Their Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian playing tabletop paper sumo with Nobita in their classroom, both leaning toward two folded wrestlers standing in a small ring. Their fingers hover beside the game board, with motion marks around their hands. Classroom desks, window frames, and floor tiles surround the central activity on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Watching a UFO and Tentacled Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian and Suneo stare in surprise at a flying saucer and an octopus-shaped robot alien in this printable coloring page, with Doraemon between them below. The hovering robot has curved tentacles, an antenna, and round ear-like panels. Large open faces and mechanical details share the coloring sheet beneath a few outlined clouds.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Campaigning Against Nobita to Become the Neighborhood Leader Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian campaigning against Nobita to become the neighborhood leader, both wearing diagonal sashes and holding papers while standing on separate benches. Gian raises a fist above his head as Nobita gestures beside him. The coloring sheet combines open clothing panels with bench planks, bushes, and nearby houses.

pages.title: Boy Beside a Haloed Woman Holding an Axe Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian appears in his handsome transformation beside the Woodcutter's Spring Goddess in this printable coloring page, stepping forward near a rocky pool as she holds an axe. A halo floats above her long hair and draped gown. The coloring sheet contrasts Gian's zigzag shirt with flowing fabric folds, stones, and small water ripples.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Wearing the Super Gian Cape and Flying to Answer a Whistle Call Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian wearing the Super Gian cape and flying to answer a whistle call, stretching one fist forward above the neighborhood rooftops. Nobita stands below with a whistle at his mouth. The sweeping cape and large central figure fill the coloring sheet, with clouds and house windows around them.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Throwing a Snowball During a Christmas Snowball Fight with Nobita Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian throws a snowball during a Christmas snowball fight with Nobita in this printable coloring page, wearing a pom-pom hat, scarf, and mittens in the snow. Nobita leans away from the approaching ball. A decorated tree with a star, bows, and round ornaments supplies smaller festive sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Skiing Down the Small Snow Slope in the Vacant Lot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian skiing down a small snow slope in the vacant lot, crouching over long skis while holding a pole in each hand. Doraemon, Nobita, Shizuka, and Suneo watch from above near the concrete pipes. Boot straps, scarf fringes, and scattered snow shapes add fine details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Helping Suneo Assemble Stalls for Doraemon's Miniature Summer Festival Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian helps Suneo assemble stalls for Doraemon's miniature summer festival in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside a little booth while Doraemon watches behind them. Striped lanterns hang beneath scalloped canopies, with loose planks nearby. The coloring sheet features small bowls and display items within the miniature stands, framed by the larger characters.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Walking with Shizuka Through a Park Filled with Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian walking with Shizuka through a park filled with autumn leaves, both looking toward each other as they follow a curved path. Lobed leaves fall between the trees and scatter underfoot. The coloring sheet keeps their broad clothing areas central, surrounded by smaller leaf outlines and a park bench.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Taking a Classroom Test with the Computer Pencil Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian takes a classroom test with the Computer Pencil in this printable coloring page, leaning over a sheet of paper with his eyebrows drawn down. The pencil has a small inset panel and rounded top. The coloring sheet centers on his seated figure, desk, and chair, with a window and board behind him.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Arriving at Nobita's Front Door with His Belongings After Leaving Home Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian arriving at Nobita's front door with his belongings after leaving home, carrying a large tied bundle over one shoulder beside the doorstep. His downturned mouth and slanted eyebrows define his expression. Broad areas on the bag and shirt contrast with the door panels and surrounding wall on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Exploring a Halloween Castle Maze with Suneo Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian explores a Halloween castle maze with Suneo in this printable coloring page, the two boys standing between stone walls lined with arched openings and cobwebs. Gian wears a broad-striped shirt while Suneo has his usual pointed hairstyle. The coloring sheet includes small masonry blocks and web sections around the larger character outlines.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Tending an Underwater Barbecue Beside a Lake-bottom Tent Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian tending an underwater barbecue beside a lake-bottom tent, holding tongs over a round grill as fish and bubbles float above. Grill marks cross the food, and a skewer rests along the grate. The coloring sheet adds a domed tent, rocks, and waving aquatic plants around Gian.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Floating on the Time Tunnel After Mistaking It for a Banana Boat Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian floats on the Time Tunnel after mistaking it for a banana boat in this printable coloring page, gripping two handles with a startled open-mouthed expression. His legs straddle the curved, pointed inflatable shape. Wide spiraling bands and scattered oval forms surround the central figure, giving the coloring sheet an expansive tunnel background.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Angrily Chasing Nobita Along a Neighborhood Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian angrily chasing Nobita along a neighborhood street, running with clenched fists while Nobita looks worried and hurries ahead of him. Their lifted shoes and bent elbows emphasize the running poses. Tall walls, house windows, and overhead utility wires frame the two figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Traveling with Doraemon and Nobita Aboard the Time Machine Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian travels with Doraemon and Nobita aboard the Time Machine in this printable coloring page, sitting behind them while Doraemon grips two levers at the front. Nobita rests his hands on his knees beside the console. Rounded side rails and broad tunnel rings frame the three smiling characters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Wearing Prehistoric Clothes Beside Kukuru at a Stone Age Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian wearing prehistoric clothes beside Kukuru at a Stone Age cave, standing with crossed arms in a ragged tunic and tied sandals. Kukuru wears a pointed pendant necklace and stands barefoot nearby. The coloring sheet combines large clothing areas with jagged hems, cord ties, and the cave's uneven rock contours.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Riding Gol the Tyrannosaurus Across a Prehistoric Plain Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian rides Gol the Tyrannosaurus across a prehistoric plain in this printable coloring page, raising one fist while sitting behind the dinosaur's large smiling head. Gol has pointed teeth, small forearms, and a long raised tail. Ferns, scattered stones, and distant hills surround the broad dinosaur silhouette on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Exploring the Jungle with Peko in His Expedition Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian exploring the jungle with Peko in his expedition outfit, parting a large leaf as Peko points along the narrow path. Gian wears a brimmed hat, pocketed shirt, boots, and a shoulder bag. Dense outlined foliage surrounds the pair, adding many individual leaf sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Wearing Winter Expedition Clothes Among Antarctica's Frozen Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian wears winter expedition clothes among Antarctica's frozen ruins in this printable coloring page, standing in a padded jacket, mittens, pocketed trousers, and thick-soled boots beside ice-covered masonry. His jacket has a fluffy collar and cuffs. Icicles, broken columns, and snowy ground create smaller shapes around the central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Studying a Treasure Map Aboard the Nobitaora Sailing Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian studying a treasure map aboard the Nobitaora sailing ship, holding an unrolled chart with a dotted route ending at an X. He stands beside a mast wrapped with rope. The coloring sheet pairs the map's island outlines with deck planks, railing posts, and Gian's broad striped shirt.

pages.title: Gian in Armor Holding a Sword Beneath an Arch Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian wears swordsman armor and holds his sword in Nobita's Three Visionary Swordsmen in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a stone arch with a cape behind him. Rounded shoulder plates and wrist guards divide his outfit. The coloring sheet includes a long upright blade, belt buckle, boot cuffs, and rectangular paving stones.

pages.title: Gian and Suneo Wearing Gorilla and Fox Costumes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gian in his gorilla disguise beside Suneo in his fox disguise on Animal Planet, both standing on grass with smiling faces. Gian's hood has round ears and a broad muzzle, while Suneo's has pointed ears. Jagged fur outlines, paw shapes, and Suneo's bushy tail define the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Acting in His Space Heroes Costume in Front of Burger Director's Camera Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian acts in his Space Heroes costume before Burger Director's camera in this printable coloring page, raising a fist while wearing a cape and round chest emblem. The small burger-shaped director operates a tripod-mounted movie camera nearby. Stars, planets, rocky ground, and distant futuristic towers provide varied background sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Shrunk to Papi's Size Beside the Tiny Alien's Rocket in Little Star Wars Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian shrunk to Papi's size beside the tiny alien's rocket in Little Star Wars, standing among towering blades of grass nearby. Papi waves beside the pointed spacecraft, which has a round window and side fins. Broad character shapes and narrow grass sections create contrasting areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Looking Through a Galaxy Express Train Window at Planets and Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian looks through a Galaxy Express train window at planets and stars in this printable coloring page, resting one hand on the sill beside the carriage seat. A large ringed planet appears among patterned spheres and pointed stars. The coloring sheet contrasts the window's small space details with wide shirt bands and plain interior panels.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Exploring the Moon's Rabbit Kingdom with Luka Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Gian exploring the Moon's Rabbit Kingdom with Luka, walking beside his long-eared companion across a cratered landscape beneath scattered outlined stars. Luka wears a belted tunic and tall boots. Rabbit-shaped buildings with arched doorways add small architectural sections behind the two large figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Two Turbaned Figures Walking Through a Market Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian walks with Mikujin through an Arabian market in Nobita's Dorabian Nights in this printable coloring page, both wearing turbans, loose trousers, and curled-toe shoes as they pass stalls. Mikujin has a curled mustache and open vest. Draped awnings, patterned jars, and domed buildings form smaller sections behind them on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian Studying a Miniature Planet with Doraemon's World Creation Set Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian studying a miniature planet with Doraemon's World Creation Set, leaning over a table toward a globe enclosed in a rounded chamber. Outlined continents cover the small world above a control base. Bottles, test tubes, and a box add geometric details beside Gian's broad striped shirt on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian in Cherry Blossom Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian stands with Doraemon in a cherry blossom park in this printable coloring page, smiling beside his friend beneath flowering trees with drifting petals around them. Doraemon holds a skewer of round treats and raises one paw. Repeated blossoms, scattered petals, and a winding path surround the two broad figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian in School Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gian in a school classroom, smiling with closed eyes and his hands on his hips while wearing a backpack and whistle. A board behind him shows numbers, basic shapes, and a smiling face. Rows of desks and window frames add narrower sections around his large outline on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian in Amusement Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian visits an amusement park with Doraemon in this printable coloring page, smiling with both hands raised while wearing an open vest over a spiral-patterned shirt. Carousel horses and a roller coaster rise behind them. The coloring sheet combines broad character outlines with smaller ride structures, saddle shapes, and surrounding tree contours.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian in Japanese Neighborhood Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gian standing in a Japanese neighborhood with his arms crossed, smiling in a broad-striped shirt between houses, garden walls, and gates. Utility wires stretch overhead, and a flowering branch enters from above. The coloring sheet places smaller roof, fence, and window sections around his large central figure.

pages.title: Doraemon Gian on Riverbank Coloring Page
pages.description: Gian sits on a riverbank in this printable coloring page, resting both hands on his knees while a winding river curves past grassy slopes behind him. Small trees, distant hills, and rounded clouds frame the scene. His broad shirt bands and shorts form large areas, with pebbles and grass adding smaller details to the coloring sheet.
